optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Delivery Project Coordinator, Retail Store Operations

professionalSummary.text: Owns the end-to-end rollout plan for an assigned wave of stores, from scheduling through readiness sign-off, and is accountable for the wave's delivery.
professionalSummary.witness: Coordinated the schedule for wave 3 of the point-of-sale rollout (26 stores) in the programme planning tool, keeping the readiness tracker current and re-sequencing store visits when field engineers were reassigned. Raised scheduling and stock blockers to the programme lead with a suggested option; decisions on store priority and any date changes were taken by the programme lead, and readiness sign-off for each store was given by the regional operations manager.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintains the store-readiness tracker and the field-engineer schedule in the programme's planning tool.
experienceHighlights.witness: Coordinated the schedule for wave 3 of the point-of-sale rollout (26 stores) in the programme planning tool, keeping the readiness tracker current and re-sequencing store visits when field engineers were reassigned.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Runs weekly readiness calls with regional operations and IT field services and records decisions and open items.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Prepared the agenda and minutes for the weekly readiness call with regional operations and IT field services, and followed up on the open items list between calls.

skills.text: Escalates blockers to the programme lead with a recommended resolution and documents who decided what.
skills.witness: Raised scheduling and stock blockers to the programme lead with a suggested option; decisions on store priority and any date changes were taken by the programme lead, and readiness sign-off for each store was given by the regional operations manager.

optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The materials establish that the candidate owns the rollout plan, maintains the tracker, runs readiness calls, escalates blockers, and produces the close-out report. They do not establish that the candidate is the single accountable person for the wave's delivery or that they have run a rollout end-to-end.

decisionBoundary.statement: The candidate has strong evidence for several requirements but lacks clear evidence for being the single accountable person for the wave's delivery and running a rollout end-to-end.
